name: ngh-app
description: Northwood Game Haven — iOS/Android app shell (Capacitor) around site/app. NGH-BUILD 2026-09-11a

scripts.add:android: npm run sync-web && npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
scripts.add:ios: npm run sync-web && npx cap add ios
scripts.sync: npm run sync-web && npx cap sync
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
